program.name: CalFresh expedited-service indicator
program.description: Checks the three crisis indicators described in the County expedited-services desk aid.

versions.source_label: County of San Diego CalFresh Desk Aid 11: Expedited Services
versions.notice: Indicator only. The County decides expedited eligibility; an interview and identity verification are still required before issuance.

conditions.pass_reason: Reported monthly gross income is below $150.
conditions.fail_reason: The under-$150 income test was not met.
conditions.unknown_reason: Monthly income is needed for the first expedited test.

conditions.pass_reason: Reported liquid resources are $100 or less.
conditions.fail_reason: The $100 liquid-resource test was not met.
conditions.unknown_reason: Liquid resources are needed for the expedited test.
conditions.requirement: Cash and liquid resources available now

conditions.pass_reason: Reported income plus liquid resources are less than reported shelter and utility costs.
conditions.fail_reason: The shelter-cost comparison was not met.
conditions.unknown_reason: Income, liquid resources, shelter cost, and utilities are needed for this comparison.
conditions.expected_text: Income plus liquid resources is less than shelter plus utility costs

conditions.pass_reason: A migrant/seasonal farmworker household was reported.
conditions.fail_reason: The migrant/seasonal farmworker test was not selected.
conditions.unknown_reason: Farmworker status is needed for this expedited branch.
conditions.requirement: Migrant or seasonal farmworker crisis route

conditions.pass_reason: Reported liquid resources are $100 or less.
conditions.fail_reason: The $100 liquid-resource test was not met.
conditions.unknown_reason: Liquid resources are needed for this expedited branch.
conditions.requirement: Cash and liquid resources available now

next_steps.MAY_QUALIFY: Tell the County, 211 enrollment worker, or application partner that you need expedited CalFresh and submit identity proof as quickly as possible.
next_steps.NEEDS_INFORMATION: You can skip these questions and still use immediate food resources; a worker can screen expedited service by phone.
next_steps.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The three simplified crisis indicators were not met based on current answers; ordinary CalFresh processing may still be available.
next_steps.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: Ask the County to screen current expedited rules.

result_summaries.DIRECT_RESOURCE: Available to everyone without completing the eligibility survey.
result_summaries.LIKELY_ELIGIBLE: Your current answers meet every rule included in this pre-screen. The official agency still decides.
result_summaries.MAY_QUALIFY: Your current answers make this a useful next step, but the provider or agency must confirm remaining requirements.
result_summaries.NEEDS_INFORMATION: A small number of unanswered items could change this result.
result_summaries.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: At least one current answer does not meet this pre-screen. Open the details to compare what was expected with what you entered.
result_summaries.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: SANDI will not rely on this rule until its owner reviews the current version.
